findings_qualitative.value: [CI] and dust continuum are strongly correlated, more so than CO(4-3) and continuum, suggesting they trace the same gas phase

evidence.quote: CO(4–3) emission traces a warmer, denser phase of the ISM, while [Ci] and dust continuum emission both appear to trace the same phase.
